scope: Bounded original-source check for the soft-IoU referent target used by PIRS

sources.title: VarifocalNet: An IoU-aware Dense Object Detector
sources.source_observation: The original method trains an IoU-aware classification score. The target q is gt_IoU for foreground points and 0 otherwise, and the predicted IACS is used directly as the candidate ranking score.
sources.retrieval: arXiv abstract plus ar5iv full-text sections 3 and 4.2, retrieved 2026-09-17

sources.title: IoU-aware single-stage object detector for accurate localization
sources.source_observation: Direct prior work on making localization quality available to detection confidence.

assessment.prior_art_overlap: Continuous IoU-valued classification targets for ranking candidate hypotheses are established prior art.
assessment.narrow_pirs_difference: PIRS applies a detached mask-IoU target to every sparse 3D referent query, removes the seed-derived label, and retains the existing BCE referent path. It does not add asymmetric positive weighting or the VarifocalNet feature and box-refinement pipeline.
assessment.admission_gap: The M197 literature gate cites RefMask3D as original-source evidence, but its note that IoU/quality-aware classification was distinguished does not cite a direct VFNet/IACS source. M197 cannot claim core mechanism novelty from the soft-IoU target alone.
assessment.unresolved: This bounded check found no direct ScanRefer or 3D referring-expression paper using the same sparse-query mask-IoU target, but absence in a bounded search is not evidence of novelty.

action.queue: No launch, restart, stop, or queue mutation.
action.training: Continue M197 to terminal and preserve its efficacy/rejection result.
action.science: Before any paper-level novelty claim or successor, run a direct original-source audit over ScanRefer and 3D referring-expression query-selection work. Treat M197 success as mechanism/application evidence, not proof of core novelty.
